title: salvia verbenaca var. sabulicola
intro: Salvia verbenaca var. sabulicola, commonly known as  Desert Blue Sage, is a species of flowering plant in the sage family (Lamiaceae). This plant has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties, offering health benefits such as anti-inflammatory and antioxidant effects, which may help to reduce stress and improve overall well-being. The therapeutic actions of Desert Blue Sage include its ability to calm the nervous system, promote relaxation, and alleviate symptoms of anxiety and insomnia. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties and therapeutic actions.
